title: 🔴 Finally! Testing the FOKKER F27 in the NEW Scenery! 🇳🇱🇧🇪 (LIVE)
description:
The "Friendship" has finally arrived in its home skies! ✈️ Today at 20:00 CET, we are going hands-on with the legendary Fokker F27 to celebrate the brand-new Benelux World Update.

This isn't just any regional flight—it’s a celebration of Dutch aviation history combined with the stunning new scenery of Belgium and the Netherlands. In this livestream, we are doing a complete "Unpacking" of this classic twin-turboprop.

In this stream:
✅ The Scenery: Exploring the new hand-crafted landmarks in Brussels, Amsterdam, and beyond.
✅ Walkaround: A deep dive into the Fokker’s unique high-wing design and vintage gear.
✅ Cabin Tour: Checking out the classic 1950s/60s interior fidelity and passenger view.
✅ Systems: First look at the analog cockpit, engine management, and navigation.
✅ Takeoff: Setting up for a short-field regional hop to test the flight model.

Aircraft History:
We’ll also discuss the legacy of the F27—the aircraft that put Fokker on the global map and became the most successful European airliner of its era.

Topics we will discuss:

Fokker F-27
- Liveries
- Exterior walkaround & rivet detail
- Full cockpit setup & "Old School" Cold & Dark
- Engine start (The Dart sound!) & Taxi
- First takeoff and handling characteristics

City Update 14 Netherlands and Belgium
- Fly over the updated cities: 
  - NL: Brielle, Rotterdam, Eindhoven, Utrecht, Breukelen, Amsterdam
  - BE: Antwerp, Bruges, 

- Final verdict & Live Q&A
